modules.name: settings_app
modules.source:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Settings: choose a Wi-Fi network and save it in settings.json, where every app finds it
# (mpy_settings, mpy_wifi.ensure()). Scan and connect run in the background; the page's timer
# follows them, so the screen never freezes.
#
# The layout of a keyboard plugged into the board goes there too ({"keyboard": {"layout": "it"}}):
# the REPL hub, which turns its keys into text, reads it again within a second.
#
# The Controllers page pairs Bluetooth gamepads (mpy_bluetooth).
#
# In the LVGL MPY Studio simulator there is no Wi-Fi: three demo networks are shown and the
# settings are kept in memory.

import time

import lvgl as lv

try:
    import mpy_settings
    import mpy_wifi
except ImportError:
    mpy_settings = mpy_wifi = None
try:
    import mpy_bluetooth
except ImportError:
    mpy_bluetooth = None

GREEN = lv.color_hex(0x2FA36B)
ROW = lv.color_hex(0x1E2633)
DEMO = [("Home", -48.0, True), ("Workshop", -66.0, True), ("Cafe Guest", -79.0, False)]
CONNECT_SECONDS = 30
LAYOUTS = ("us", "it")  # in the order of the keyboard_layout dropdown
LAYOUT_NAMES = ("US keyboard", "Italian keyboard")

_ui = None
_job = None
_job_kind = None
_waiting_until = None
_checked = 0
_demo_settings = {}


def _row_font():
    # List rows follow the screen: bigger letters on an 800x480 screen than on a 480x272 one.
    height = lv.display_get_default().get_vertical_resolution()
    return lv.font_montserrat_24 if height >= 400 else lv.font_montserrat_14


def _say(text):
    _ui.message.set_text(text)


def _bars(dbm):
    # signal as words a maker reads at a glance
    return "strong" if dbm > -60 else "good" if dbm > -70 else "weak"


def start(ui):
    global _ui
    _ui = ui
    lv.screen_active().set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(0x121820), 0)
    ui.network_list.set_style_border_width(0, 0)
    ui.network_list.set_style_radius(10, 0)
    ui.network_list.set_style_pad_all(4, 0)
    ui.network_list.set_style_pad_row(4, 0)
    ui.scan_button.get_child(0).set_text(lv.SYMBOL.REFRESH + " Scan")
    ui.keyboard.set_size(lv.pct(100), lv.pct(48))
    ui.keyboard.align(lv.ALIGN.BOTTOM_MID, 0, 0)
    ui.keyboard.add_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)
    wifi = mpy_settings.get("wifi") if mpy_settings else _demo_settings.get("wifi")
    if wifi:
        ui.ssid.set_text(wifi.get("ssid", ""))
        ui.password.set_text(wifi.get("password", ""))
    keyboard = mpy_settings.get("keyboard") if mpy_settings else _demo_settings.get("keyboard")
    layout = (keyboard or {}).get("layout", LAYOUTS[0])
    ui.keyboard_layout.set_selected(LAYOUTS.index(layout) if layout in LAYOUTS else 0)
    choices = ui.keyboard_layout.get_list()
    choices.set_style_text_font(_row_font(), 0)
    choices.set_style_bg_color(ROW, 0)
    choices.set_style_text_color(lv.color_hex(0xE6EAF0), 0)
    choices.set_style_border_width(0, 0)
    choices.set_style_bg_color(GREEN, lv.PART.SELECTED | lv.STATE.CHECKED)
    show_status()
    scan()


def choose_layout():
    values = {"layout": LAYOUTS[_ui.keyboard_layout.get_selected()]}
    if mpy_settings is None:
        _demo_settings["keyboard"] = values
    else:
        mpy_settings.update("keyboard", values)
    _say("Saved: %s. A keyboard plugged into the board types with it." % LAYOUT_NAMES[_ui.keyboard_layout.get_selected()])


def edit(textarea):
    _ui.keyboard.set_textarea(textarea)
    _ui.keyboard.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)


def done_editing():
    _ui.keyboard.add_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)
    _ui.keyboard.set_textarea(None)
    _ui.ssid.remove_state(lv.STATE.FOCUSED)
    _ui.password.remove_state(lv.STATE.FOCUSED)


def scan():
    global _job, _job_kind
    if _job is not None:
        return
    if mpy_wifi is None:
        _fill(DEMO)
        _say("Demo networks (simulator)")
        return
    try:
        _job, _job_kind = mpy_wifi.start_scan(), "scan"
        _say("Scanning...")
    except OSError as error:
        _say("Scan failed: %s" % error)


def _fill(networks):
    _ui.network_list.clean()
    for name, dbm, secured in networks:
        row = lv.button(_ui.network_list)
        row.set_width(lv.pct(100))
        row.set_style_bg_color(ROW, 0)
        row.set_style_shadow_width(0, 0)
        label = lv.label(row)
        label.set_text("%s %s\n%s%s" % (lv.SYMBOL.WIFI, name, _bars(dbm), "  locked" if secured else "  open"))
        label.set_style_text_font(_row_font(), 0)
        label.set_long_mode(lv.label.LONG_MODE.DOTS)
        label.set_width(lv.pct(100))
        row.add_event_cb(lambda e, n=name: choose(n), lv.EVENT.CLICKED, None)


def choose(name):
    _ui.ssid.set_text(name)
    _ui.password.set_text("")
    edit(_ui.password)


def connect():
    global _job, _job_kind, _waiting_until
    done_editing()
    ssid = _ui.ssid.get_text().strip()
    password = _ui.password.get_text()
    if not ssid:
        _say("Choose or type a network name")
        return
    if password and not 8 <= len(password) <= 63:
        _say("The password must have 8 to 63 characters")
        return
    values = {"ssid": ssid, "password": password}
    if mpy_wifi is None:
        _demo_settings["wifi"] = values
        _say("Saved (simulator): " + ssid)
        return
    mpy_settings.update("wifi", values)
    try:
        _job, _job_kind = mpy_wifi.start_connect(ssid, password), "connect"
    except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
        _say("Saved, but cannot connect: %s" % error)
        return
    _waiting_until = time.ticks_add(time.ticks_ms(), CONNECT_SECONDS * 1000)
    _say("Saved. Connecting to %s..." % ssid)


def show_status():
    global _checked
    _checked = time.ticks_ms()
    if mpy_wifi is None:
        _ui.wifi_status.set_text("Simulator: no Wi-Fi")
        return False
    info = mpy_wifi.status()
    online = info.get("state") == "COMPLETED" and "ip" in info
    if online:
        _ui.wifi_status.set_text("%s Connected to %s, address %s" % (lv.SYMBOL.OK, info.get("ssid", "?"), info["ip"]))
    elif info.get("state") == "NO_INTERFACE":
        _ui.wifi_status.set_text("This board has no Wi-Fi")
    else:
        _ui.wifi_status.set_text("Not connected (%s)" % info.get("state", "?").lower())
    return online


def tick():
    global _job, _waiting_until
    if _ui is None:
        return
    if _job is not None and _job.poll() is not None:
        job, _job = _job, None
        if _job_kind == "scan":
            found = mpy_wifi.scan_results(job) if job.status == 0 else []
            _fill(found)
            _say("%d networks found" % len(found) if job.status == 0 else "Scan failed")
        elif job.status != 0:
            _waiting_until = None
            _say("Could not start Wi-Fi (%d)" % job.status)
    if time.ticks_diff(time.ticks_ms(), _checked) >= 2000 or _waiting_until is not None:
        online = show_status()
        if _waiting_until is not None:
            if online:
                _waiting_until = None
                _say("Connected. Apps that need the internet use this network.")
            elif time.ticks_diff(_waiting_until, time.ticks_ms()) <= 0:
                _waiting_until = None
                _say("Not connected: check the password and the signal.")


# --- Controllers: Bluetooth gamepads (mpy_bluetooth, BlueZ in the background) ---

BT_DEMO = [("AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:01", "8BitDo SN30 Pro+", True), ("AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:02", "Pro Controller", False)]
BT_HELP = (
    "Put the controller in pairing mode, then Search (30 seconds) and choose it by its name.\n\n"
    "8BitDo SN30 Pro+: Start with Y held (Switch) or B held (D-input), then the pair button "
    "for 3 seconds.\n\n"
    "A paired controller should connect again by itself when switched on; some (8BitDo in Switch "
    "mode) work only right after pairing. A USB cable always works, without any of this."
)
# The same, for a small screen (480x272).
BT_HELP_SHORT = (
    "Pairing mode on the controller, then Search and choose it.\n"
    "8BitDo: Start with Y (Switch) or B held, then pair for 3 s."
)


def _bt_help():
    return BT_HELP if lv.display_get_default().get_vertical_resolution() >= 400 else BT_HELP_SHORT


_bt_job = None
_bt_kind = None
_bt_rows = []
_bt_devices = []
_bt_chosen = None


def open_controllers():
    _ui.load_page(_ui.PAGE_CONTROLLERS)


def close_controllers():
    _ui.load_page(_ui.PAGE_MAIN)


def _bt_say(text):
    _ui.bt_message.set_text(text)


def bt_start(ui):
    global _ui
    _ui = ui
    lv.screen_active().set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(0x121820), 0)
    ui.bt_list.set_style_border_width(0, 0)
    ui.bt_list.set_style_radius(10, 0)
    ui.bt_list.set_style_pad_all(4, 0)
    ui.bt_list.set_style_pad_row(4, 0)
    ui.bt_scan_button.get_child(0).set_text(lv.SYMBOL.BLUETOOTH + " Search")
    ui.bt_back_button.get_child(0).set_text(lv.SYMBOL.LEFT + " Wi-Fi")
    _bt_say(_bt_help())
    _bt_fill()


def _bt_fill():
    global _bt_rows, _bt_devices, _bt_chosen
    _bt_devices = mpy_bluetooth.devices() if mpy_bluetooth else BT_DEMO
    _ui.bt_list.clean()
    _bt_rows = []
    _bt_chosen = None
    for index, (address, name, paired) in enumerate(_bt_devices):
        row = lv.button(_ui.bt_list)
        row.set_width(lv.pct(100))
        row.set_style_bg_color(ROW, 0)
        row.set_style_shadow_width(0, 0)
        label = lv.label(row)
        label.set_text("%s %s\n%s" % (lv.SYMBOL.BLUETOOTH, name, "paired" if paired else "found: choose to pair"))
        label.set_style_text_font(_row_font(), 0)
        label.set_long_mode(lv.label.LONG_MODE.DOTS)
        label.set_width(lv.pct(100))
        row.add_event_cb(lambda e, i=index: bt_choose(i), lv.EVENT.CLICKED, None)
        _bt_rows.append(row)
    paired = sum(1 for d in _bt_devices if d[2])
    _ui.bt_status.set_text("%d paired, %d found" % (paired, len(_bt_devices) - paired) if _bt_devices else "None yet: Search")


def bt_choose(index):
    """A paired controller connects; another one pairs."""
    global _bt_job, _bt_kind, _bt_chosen
    if _bt_job is not None:
        return
    for row in _bt_rows:
        row.set_style_bg_color(ROW, 0)
    _bt_chosen = index
    _bt_rows[index].set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(0x2F6FDE), 0)
    address, name, paired = _bt_devices[index]
    if mpy_bluetooth is None:
        _bt_say("Simulator: %s would %s here." % (name, "connect" if paired else "pair"))
        return
    _bt_job = mpy_bluetooth.connect(address) if paired else mpy_bluetooth.pair(address)
    _bt_kind = "connect" if paired else "pair"
    _bt_say("%s %s..." % ("Connecting" if paired else "Pairing with", name))


def bt_scan():
    global _bt_job, _bt_kind
    if _bt_job is not None:
        return
    if mpy_bluetooth is None:
        _bt_say("Simulator: no Bluetooth; two demo controllers.")
        return
    _bt_job, _bt_kind = mpy_bluetooth.scan(30), "scan"
    _ui.bt_status.set_text("Searching for 30 seconds...")


def bt_forget():
    global _bt_job, _bt_kind
    if _bt_job is not None or _bt_chosen is None:
        _bt_say("Choose a controller first.")
        return
    address, name, paired = _bt_devices[_bt_chosen]
    if mpy_bluetooth is None:
        _bt_say("Simulator: %s would be forgotten." % name)
        return
    _bt_job, _bt_kind = mpy_bluetooth.forget(address), "forget"
    _bt_say("Forgetting %s..." % name)


def bt_tick():
    global _bt_job
    if _bt_job is None or _bt_job.poll() is None:
        return
    job, _bt_job = _bt_job, None
    if _bt_kind == "scan":
        _bt_say(_bt_help())
    elif job.result:
        _bt_say({"pair": "Paired and connected: it is ready.", "connect": "Connected.",
                 "forget": "Forgotten."}[_bt_kind])
    else:
        lines = [line.strip() for line in job.text.replace("\r", "").split("\n") if "Fail" in line or "rror" in line]
        _bt_say("It did not work%s. Is the controller in pairing mode?" % (": " + lines[-1][-60:] if lines else ""))
    _bt_fill()
